skills.name: dashboard-templates
skills.description: Builds a ready-made dashboard in the user's Vantage account from one of its templates, such as the AI spend overview (AI spend this month, a three-month trend by provider, and this month by model). Shows a preview and asks before creating anything. Use when a user asks to set up, create or install a ready-made dashboard, such as an AI spend or AI costs dashboard, or asks which dashboards can be set up for them.
